description: This source file contains the implementation of integration routines for Google Cloud Vertex AI models within a larger machine learning framework. It includes classes for error handling and streaming simulation, as well as functions to handle completion requests, both synchronously and asynchronously, for various Vertex AI model types, including chat, text, code, and private endpoints. The code manages client caching, credential loading, request construction, and response parsing, facilitating seamless interaction with Vertex AI's generative models and endpoints.

classes.name: VertexAIError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to Vertex AI integration, encapsulating HTTP status code and message, and constructing dummy request/response objects for error context.

classes.name: TextStreamer
classes.description: Simulated streaming iterator that breaks text into words and yields them sequentially, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous iteration, to emulate streaming behavior in Vertex AI responses.

methods.name: _get_client_cache_key( model: str, vertex_project: Optional[str], vertex_location: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Constructs a cache key string based on model name, project, and location to identify cached Vertex AI clients.

methods.name: _get_client_from_cache(client_cache_key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached Vertex AI client instance from the in-memory cache using a cache key.

methods.name: _set_client_in_cache(client_cache_key: str, vertex_llm_model: Any)
methods.description: Stores a Vertex AI client instance in the cache with specified TTL (time-to-live) using a cache key.

methods.name: completion( model: str, messages: list, model_response: ModelResponse, print_verbose: Callable, encoding, logging_obj, optional_params: dict, vertex_project=None, vertex_location=None, vertex_credentials=None, litellm_params=None, logger_fn=None, acompletion: bool = False, )
methods.description: Main function to handle synchronous generation requests, supporting multiple mode types (chat, text, custom, private) for Vertex AI, including credential management, request construction, response parsing, error handling, and optional streaming.

methods.name: async_completion( llm_model, mode: str, prompt: str, model: str, messages: list, model_response: ModelResponse, request_str: str, print_verbose: Callable, logging_obj, encoding, client_options=None, instances=None, vertex_project=None, vertex_location=None, vertex_credentials=None, safety_settings=None, **optional_params, )
methods.description: Asynchronous counterpart to `completion`, handling non-blocking generation requests with support for different modes and detailed logging, managing async Vertex AI API calls and responses.

methods.name: async_streaming( llm_model, mode: str, prompt: str, model: str, model_response: ModelResponse, messages: list, print_verbose: Callable, logging_obj, request_str: str, encoding=None, client_options=None, instances=None, vertex_project=None, vertex_location=None, vertex_credentials=None, safety_settings=None, **optional_params, )
methods.description: Supports asynchronous streaming responses from Vertex AI models, returning a custom stream wrapper that delivers the token stream, handling different input modes and logging.
